scope: One-pass detached exact-builtin JSON copy before unchanged JSON encoding/full SHA; original freeze/thaw fallback for unsupported/deep/cyclic values. No stored digest trust or validation cache.
findings: Exact primitive values and str-keyed dict/list are copied into independent plain containers once. Aliases serialize equivalently; no mutable original is passed to json.dumps.

Nonfinite, NumPy, MappingProxy, tuple, container/scalar/key subclasses and other unsupported/deep/cyclic values fall back to the unchanged legacy normalization. Unsupported callbacks are not speculatively invoked.

Literal-legacy encoded bytes/digests/exception types and messages, fresh mutations and post-copy/pre-dump mutation isolation tested. Neither old nor new path claims an atomic snapshot against concurrent changes during traversal.
limits: Pure-data/engineering tests only; no patient engine/replay/GUI or production edits by reviewer. Saved-state kernel timing belongs to worker; no whole-episode speed claim.
